problem.question: Enrique has 2 132 contracts that he needs to shred.  His paper shredder will only allow him to shred 6 pages at a time.  How many times will he shred 6 units of paper until all of the contracts are shredded?
problem.answer:
He has 2 contracts that are 132 pages each so that's 2*132 = <<2*132=264>>264 pages
He can only shred 6 pages at a time so it will take him 264/6 = <<264/6=44>>44 units
#### 44
